the-chairman-of-class-9.synopsis: يصبح طالب جانح في السنة الثانية رئيسًا لمجلس إدارة مدرسة ثانوية مرموقة تركها والده وراءه. ربما نشأ نا يي سو في بيئة قد يحسدها الآخرون، لكنه يحمل الكراهية لوالده ويتوجه إلى مدرسة بالها الثانوية، التي كان والده يعتز بها، من أجل الانتقام. إن عملية التغيير بين يي سو، الذي عاش حياة أقسى من أي شخص آخر، ونخبة الطلاب في البلاد الذين عاشوا حياة مستقيمة، حيث يتعرفون على بعضهم البعض، والحب الذي يزدهر في هذه العملية، ستكون ديناميكيًا. تكشف

النهب.title: النهب
النهب.synopsis: في عام 1998، تعرضت إليف جينار، زوجة رؤوف جينار، أحد أساتذة الاقتصاد البارزين في البلاد، للطعن على يد لص يُدعى نجيب تالان. تتغير حياة هاتين العائلتين من عالمين مختلفين تمامًا بعد تلك الليلة. ابنة رؤوف جينار، زينب جينار، فقدت والدتها الوحيدة في تلك الليلة؛ أكاي تالان يفقد والده، بطله الوحيد. أكاي تالان، الذي أصبح مجهولاً ومجهول الاسم ومشرداً في ليلة واحدة، اليوم، تحت اسم كارا، أقسم أن يسرق ممن يسرقوننا حتى لا يعاني أي طفل من نفس مصيره. تعود زينب جينار إلى إسطنبول بعد الدراسة في الخارج. تواصل حبها للنباتات التي ورثتها عن والدتها من خلال الأفلام الوثائقية التي تصنعها. الشيء الوحيد المشترك بين هذين الشخصين من عالمين مختلفين هو تلك الليلة. سواء شاءوا ذلك أم لا، ستجمعهم الحياة وجهاً لوجه مرة أخرى، وحتى العوائق التي تقف أمامهم لن تمنعهم من الوقوع في الحب. ولكن ماذا يحدث عندما تظهر الحقيقة؟

قيامة-ارطغرل.title: قيامة ارطغرل
قيامة-ارطغرل.synopsis: مسلسل تاريخي تركي تقع أحداثه في القرن 13 الميلادي، ويعرض سيرة حياة أرطغرل بن سليمان شاه، قائد قبيلة قايي من أتراك الأوغوز المسلمين ووالد عثمان الأول مؤسس الدولة العثمانية

cape-fear.title: Cape Fear
cape-fear.synopsis: توشك حياة محاميين هنيئين في زواجهما على الانقلاب رأساً على عقب بعدما خرج من السجن قاتل عتيد الإجرام له صلة مسبقة بهما.

the-last-man-on-earth.title: The Last Man on Earth
the-last-man-on-earth.synopsis: تدور أحداث المسلسل عام 2020 عندما انتشر فيروس مميت على كوكب الأرض ليكتشف “فيل ميلر” إنه الرجل الوحيد على وجه الأرض ويقرر الإقدام على الانتحار، ثم يجد ناجية أخرى فيتراجع عن قراره، لتتعقد الأمور كلما وجدا ناجين آخرين.

revenge.title: Revenge
revenge.synopsis: تدور أحداث المسلسل في أحد مجتمعات الطبقة العليا ببلدة هامبتون الأمريكية ويركز المسلسل على إيميلي ثورن‏ التي استأجرت المنزل المجاور لعائلة غرايسون  للإستمتاع بالصيف. ثم يتبين أن إيميلي قد أتت من قبل لبلدة هامبتون وأن اسمها الحقيقي هو أماندا كلاركوهي ابنة متهم بتفجير طائرة قد حكم عليه بالسجن المؤبد الجريمة التي لم يرتكبها وقد قتل في وقت لاحق بالسجن.  لذا فقد عادت (إميلي) لبلدة هامبتون عازمة على الثأر والانتقام لوالدها الذي دفع ثمن جريمة شنعاء لم يرتكبها. فهي تريد أن تنتقم من كل شخص كان له دور في تدمير طفولتها، وكل أسرة أو شخصية عملت مع عائلة غرايسون لإدانة والدها ظلما. وعلى رأس القائمة التي وضعتها إيميلي للانتقام، فيكتوريا غرايسون الأم الحاكمة لأسرة غرايسون وهي إمراة أحبها والدها لكن في نهاية المطاف خانته وغدرت به.

dexter.title: Dexter
dexter.synopsis: في الصباح يعمل كخبير في الطب الشرعي لشرطة ميامي وفي المساء يعمل كسفاح للمجرمين الذي يعتقد بأنهم لم يتلقوا العدالة

land-of-women.title: Land of Women
land-of-women.synopsis: تُضطر شخصية بارزة من "نيويورك" إلى الهرب رفقة أمّها وابنتها إلى بلدة إسبانية ساحرة تشتهر بتصنيع النبيذ. فتجد نفسها في تتعرف إلى الخصائص العجيبة التي تميّز البلدات الصغيرة، بينما تواجه أسرار عائلتها الكبرى وقاتلين مأجورين أخرقين.

بيت-الصيف-summer-house-2026.title: Summer House
بيت-الصيف-summer-house-2026.synopsis: Selin travels back in time at a summer house and finds herself in her mother's youth, changing her family's fate and rebuilding her own life.

شرقي-do-ulu-2025.title: Doğulu
شرقي-do-ulu-2025.synopsis: After being released from prison, where they had been incarcerated for many years, Fırat Doğulu and his companion Akın find themselves embroiled in a relentless quest for revenge.

مواجهة-أردا-توران-arda-turan-yuzlesme-20.title: Arda Turan Yuzlesme
مواجهة-أردا-توران-arda-turan-yuzlesme-20.originalTitle: مواجهة أردا توران Arda Turan Yuzlesme 2024
مواجهة-أردا-توران-arda-turan-yuzlesme-20.synopsis: Arda Turan shares the most intimate details of his well-known personal life, starting on the streets of Bayrampaşa and leading up to Ali Sami Yen, Vicente Calderon and finally to Camp Nou.

أومامي-umami-2025.title: Umami
أومامي-umami-2025.synopsis: Chef and owner Sina Bora faces personal and professional challenges on one of his restaurant's busiest nights. His father's emergency surgery, staff tensions and his former mentor Renzo's plans to take over push Sina to make tough decisions.

المقاومة-mukavemet-2022.title: Mukavemet
المقاومة-mukavemet-2022.synopsis: Ecem and Rahmi, who are at the very beginning of their relationship, live in the basement of an apartment in Istanbul. Their life takes a different turn one night when Ecem's ex-boyfriend Kazim comes to their doorstep. The anger of Rahmi, who is very jealous, causes a night full of regrets.

concrete-market-2025.title: Concrete Market
concrete-market-2025.synopsis: After an apocalyptic earthquake, the only remaining apartment complex turns into a market where survivors buy and sell whatever it takes to survive.

revolver-2024.title: Revolver
revolver-2024.synopsis: Using a screen recording of the process of scrolling through dozens of images, the film resembles the mesmerizing and violent movements of a revolver.

detective-chinatown-1900-2025.title: Detective Chinatown
detective-chinatown-1900-2025.synopsis: In 1900, the mysterious murder of a white woman and a Native American man in San Francisco's Chinatown triggers a race against time as the Chinese suspect and the Native American's adopted Chinese son work to uncover the truth while a politician seeks to leverage the Chinese Exclusion Bill as well as the prevailing xenophobia and racism to close down Chinatown and elect himself as the mayor.

qodrat-2-2025.title: Qodrat 2
qodrat-2-2025.synopsis: Ustadz Qodrat now embarks on the next journey to find his wife, Azizah and once again strike the revenge of evil powers.

mantis-2025.title: Mantis
mantis-2025.synopsis: Inside an apartment in Milan, two gay boys talk about their feelings towards dating apps.

strangers-when-we-meet-2024.title: Strangers When We Meet
strangers-when-we-meet-2024.synopsis: After serving 30 years in prison, Lao Qin starts a new life with 1.5 million compensation from the government for demolition and relocation. He just wants to marry a wife and have children to live in peace, but his life is completely changed with the intrusion of the eccentric 24-year-old girl Chang Juan.

operation-undead-2024.title: Operation Undead
operation-undead-2024.synopsis: Inexperienced Thai soldiers battle a growing undead menace in this gruesome survival horror. A Japanese military experiment that turns men into monsters escapes containment, it’s up to these troops to save their nation from annihilation.

cast.name: ชานน สันตินธรกุล
อวัช รัตนปิณฑะ
ธนดล เอื้อพงษ์
ธนกร ติยานนท์
ธิฐิธรรม แสงมณี

creators: ก้องเกียรติ โขมศิริ

a-strange-house-2024.title: A Strange House
a-strange-house-2024.synopsis: Amemiya is an unpopular Youtuber who specializes in the occult. One day, his manager brings him a floor plan with an inscrutable point. With the help of Kurihara and Yuzuki, he begins to look into the plan and reveal the mystery behind.

evil-does-not-exist-2023.title: Evil Does Not Exist
evil-does-not-exist-2023.synopsis: كان تاكومي وابنته هانا يعيشان حياة هادئة وبسيطة في مرتفعات غنية بالطبيعة. تقع قريتهم في مدينة ميزوبيكي بمحافظة ناغانو، التي تبعد مسافة قصيرة عن طوكيو، وتشهد تطورًا سريعًا بسبب زيادة أعداد المهاجرين. في يوم من الأيام، وبعد تأثير جائحة كورونا على وكالة فنون، حصلت الوكالة على دعم حكومي لتطوير موقع للتخييم الفاخر (غرانكامبينغ)، لكن الخطة كانت مليئة بالإهمال والمشاكل.

sirai-2025.title: Sirai
sirai-2025.synopsis: As he transfers a young convict from prison to court, a police officer learns about the chain of events that led to the young man's conviction for violence.

sabdham-2025.title: Sabdham
sabdham-2025.synopsis: A paranormal investigator is employed by a university to investigate a series of mysterious deaths some are attributing to supernatural causes.

operation-laila-2024.title: Operation Laila
operation-laila-2024.synopsis: Surya, a sincere police officer, has a twin brother, Ravi, who becomes a beloved Drill Master at a school. Ravi falls in love with teacher Anjali. They encounter a ghost named Laila, seeking revenge for her murder. As Laila targets the school's staff, Surya must stop her or risk losing more lives.

kesari-chapter-2-2025.title: Kesari Chapter 2
kesari-chapter-2-2025.synopsis: A dramatization of the life story of C. Sankaran Nair, the lawyer who fought for the truth behind the Jallianwala Bagh massacre.

bhool-chuk-maaf-2025.title: Bhool Chuk Maaf
bhool-chuk-maaf-2025.synopsis: Ranjan, a small-town romantic boy from Banaras, lands a government job to marry Titli, but forgets to vow to Lord Shiva, causing him to be trapped in a time loop. A tale of love, fate, and redemption unfolds, as Ranjan tries to end the loop and get married.

zwigato-2022.title: Zwigato
zwigato-2022.synopsis: Manas, an ex-factory floor manager loses his job during the pandemic. He is then forced to work as a food delivery rider, grappling with the app and the world of ratings and incentives. Life is relentless for him, but not without shared moments of joy with his wife, Pratima. The film captures the life of invisible 'ordinary' people, hidden in plain sight.

haseen-dillruba-2021.title: Haseen Dillruba
haseen-dillruba-2021.synopsis: Under investigation as a suspect in her husband's murder, a wife reveals details of their thorny marriage that seem to only further blur the truth.

the-akaali-2024.title: The Akaali
the-akaali-2024.synopsis: A newly appointed I.O. who finds herself digging into the past regarding a 7-year-old case where occult gangs and forces have been responsible for a series of satanic killings in the city. With the help of an ex-cop, can she race against time, hierarchy and sanity to stop a rituals and solve the case?

o2-2024.title: O2
o2-2024.synopsis: A brilliant doctor battles her childhood trauma, to revive the dead with an illegal intravenous oxygen drug. Her quest challenges the boundaries of science, spirituality, and love. Will she succeed or lose everything!

hi-nanna-2023.title: Hi Nanna
hi-nanna-2023.synopsis: Six-year-old Mahi, a spirited child with cystic fibrosis, shares a deep yet complex bond with her father, Viraj, a dedicated single parent and successful fashion photographer. Her curiosity about her absent mother leads to a journey of discovery when she runs away with her loyal dog, Pluto. A chance encounter with a kind woman named Yashna sparks unexpected revelations, intertwining their lives in ways they never anticipated. Set against a backdrop of love, sacrifice, and redemption, Mahi’s story is a heartfelt exploration of family, resilience, and the enduring power of connection.

the-kerala-story-2023.title: The Kerala Story
the-kerala-story-2023.synopsis: A converted Muslim woman narrates her ordeal of how she once wanted to become a nurse but was abducted from her home and manipulated by religious vanguards and turned into an ISIS terrorist and landed in Afghanistan jail.

baaghi-2016.title: Baaghi
baaghi-2016.synopsis: تدور القصة حول روني، الذي أمره بي بي كورانا بإطلاق سراح ابنته سيا التي يحتجزها راغاف في بانكوك. المهمة ليست سهلة على روني، لأنه يحب سيا وتعرف عليها في رحلته، حيث كان من المفترض أن يتعلم فنون الدفاع عن النفس من والد راغاف. لكن راغاف أيضًا مغرم بسيا ويحاول كل شيء للفوز بسيا، وكان الاختطاف خطته الأخيرة. لكن عليه أولاً أن يتخلص من روني، لأنه سيفعل أي شيء من أجل حبه الكبير.

broken-land-2024.title: Broken Land
broken-land-2024.synopsis: An embittered Texas border rancher mistakenly shoots a young migrant woman as she crosses his property and must decide whether to help her, risking discovery by his estranged son, a Border Patrol Agent.

speed-demon-2026.title: Speed Demon
speed-demon-2026.synopsis: Aboard a high-speed train, a Nun who lost her faith must perform her first Exorcism on a possessed passenger hellbent on crashing the runaway train.

my-best-friend-s-dead-2026.title: My Best Friend’s Dead
my-best-friend-s-dead-2026.synopsis: Olivia and Aurora have been through it all together: boys, parties, death, undeath...But when men begin to go missing around their isolated farmhouse, Olivia realizes her terrifying secret is about to be revealed, leaving countless bodies in its wake.

mother-mary-2026.title: Mother Mary
mother-mary-2026.synopsis: Long-buried wounds rise to the surface when iconic pop star Mother Mary reunites with her estranged best friend and former costume designer Sam Anselm on the eve of her comeback performance.

the-secret-agent-2025.title: The Secret Agent
the-secret-agent-2025.synopsis: An adaptation of the 1907 political novel of the same title by Joseph Conrad set in Portugal during the so-called "Hot Summer" of 1975, re-contextualizing the anarchist prose within the Carnation Revolution.

ya-no-quedan-junglas-2025.title: Ya No Quedan Junglas
ya-no-quedan-junglas-2025.synopsis: Aging ex-soldier Theo meets weekly with prostitute Olga to reminisce. After Olga's murder, Theo seeks bloody revenge, attracting attention of alcoholic cop Iborra and hitman Herodes.

return-to-wickensburg-2024.title: Return to Wickensburg
return-to-wickensburg-2024.synopsis: Mr. Hexenmeister has escaped from prison, and once again threatens Wickensburg. It's a race against time to find an ancient orb, capable of destroying the entire town, before it falls into the wrong hands.

cannibal-holocaust-1980.title: Cannibal Holocaust
cannibal-holocaust-1980.synopsis: A New York University professor returns from a rescue mission to the Amazon rainforest with the footage shot by a lost team of documentarians who were making a film about the area's local cannibal tribes.

quantum-love-2014.title: Quantum Love
quantum-love-2014.synopsis: Pierre has been happily married for fifteen years and a good father. Still in love with his wife, he enjoys his wife and family and is content. One evening, he meets Elsa at a party and are immediately attracted to each other. Fifteen days later, they happen to meet again and the mutual attraction turns into infatuation. But his love for his wife and Elsa's rule about not dating married men prevents them from taking the next step. Instead, they fantasize about each other, and soon the fantasies mingle with the reality.

stormskerry-maja-2024.title: Stormskerry Maja
stormskerry-maja-2024.synopsis: Maja and Janne move to the barren and remote island of Stormskerry, where survival is a daily struggle. Growing up in a world of old values, Maja becomes aware of a new era: a woman can be an equal partner instead of a mere bystander. The couple have children, and life is good until trouble sets in: war arrives on the island, Janne is forced to flee from the English troops, and Maja and the children are imprisoned. The family also faces many financial difficulties and death. Years pass, but Maja remains strong and stays in Stormskerry despite all the hardships and difficulties.

valentine-s-town-2024.title: Valentine’s Town
valentine-s-town-2024.synopsis: Jude works for a well-known dating service that will develop a cheesy, romantic resort in his hometown of Arrowheart. Local businesswoman Melissa has organized the town against the resort. Melissa is Jude's former high school sweetheart.

close-to-you-2023.title: Close to You
close-to-you-2023.synopsis: A trans man returns to his hometown for the first time in years. On his journey, he confronts his relationship with his family, reunites with a first love, and discovers a newfound confidence in himself.

gracie-and-pedro-pets-to-the-rescue-2024.title: Gracie and Pedro Pets to the Rescue
gracie-and-pedro-pets-to-the-rescue-2024.titleEn: Gracie and Pedro Pets to the Rescue
gracie-and-pedro-pets-to-the-rescue-2024.originalTitle: Gracie and Pedro Pets to the Rescue 2024
gracie-and-pedro-pets-to-the-rescue-2024.synopsis: Family frenemies, Gracie and Pedro, must put their differences aside, embarking on a thrilling quest packed with perilous escapades in order to reunite with their owners.

polara-2024.title: Polara
polara-2024.synopsis: On TJ's 18th birthday, a stranger delivers him a key from his father, last seen as he was hauled off to prison eight years earlier. With the key is an address for a proposed meeting – 3000 miles away and in two weeks. The key unlocks a timeworn 1968 convertible, with a coffin welded to its floor. With each decision that follows, TJ plunges deeper into the mysterious and beautiful landscapes we all navigate – on our own, with our tribe, through the shifting turns of the road ahead.

looking-for-dr-love-2024.title: Looking for Dr. Love
looking-for-dr-love-2024.synopsis: A romantic comedy about a young, divorced woman who sets out to reconnect with her college sweetheart only to discover that he has been a part of her life all along.

relax-i-m-from-the-future-2022.title: Relax, I’m from the Future
relax-i-m-from-the-future-2022.synopsis: Casper is a time traveller who arrives in the 2020s in an attempt to prevent a major future catastrophe. He meets Holly, a queer black woman he befriends and draws into his plan by giving her his knowledge of the future so that she can make quick money. However, they unwittingly alter the future themselves with their actions, until Doris, another time traveller, arrives to stop them.

gaami-2024.title: Gaami
gaami-2024.synopsis: Shankar is a wounded, reluctant and reclusive aghora on a quest to find the cure for his very rare human condition – the one that will be cured, only when he can confront and conquers the haunting ironical questions of his life.
